name: [[570,38,9]] periodic bivariate-bicycle on Z_19 x Z_15

provenance.construction: Periodic bivariate-bicycle code on the group algebra Z_19 x Z_15 (n = 2*l*m = 570). Convention: x = S_19 tensor I_15, y = I_19 tensor S_15 (cyclic shifts), qubit index = i*m + j; A = 1 + x^0y^11 + x^7y^2 + x^7y^8, B = 1 + x^0y^1; H_X = [A|B], H_Z = [B^T|A^T]. Found by an automated evolutionary/mutation search over (l, m, A, B) exponent sets targeting the unrestricted x weight-6 (or weight-8) board cells, screened by a randomized lightest-logical surrogate and promoted through increasing trial budgets.
provenance.notes: Internal autoresearch candidate id 45017 (canonical key 347e0a320d05b5fda6d9bd03), search lane 'high-distance-transfer', proposal kernel 'exact-geometry-transfer'. Initial NumPy lightest-logical surrogate: trials=8000, seed=1438691877. Confirmed with an accelerated bit-packed random-information-set search at rung '1m' (1000000 trials, seed=417531131, pair_depth=16), tightest witness on side X at weight 9. Distance also taken through an internal exact-certification pipeline (MILP, one solve per logical-basis row per side, the same method as this repository's own verify/certify.py). Result: side_status X=exact, Z=exact (solver wall time 45681.2s, CPU time 45095.5s, summed over all per-row MILP solves on both sides).
